newsitem.title: UK: UK Japanese stocks trade quietly with firmer bias.
newsitem.headline: UK Japanese stocks trade quietly with firmer bias.

text.p: Japanese stocks traded here took a firmer overall bias with dealers reporting thin end-of-week volumes and few corporate features.
The Nikkei 50 was 2.35 points higher at 1,510.9 by 1330 GMT.
Taisei put on about 24 yen to 456 yen after news following the Tokyo close that the company was to buy back up to 25 billion yen of its shares, dealers said.
Mitsubishi Motors fell about ten yen to 898 yen after the company said it posted an appraisal loss for its Californian subsidiary of 43.1 billion yen in 1996/97.
